_finding: What verify_anchor hands an agent is read from disk here, and what a calendar hands us is written here. A proof is a proof OF something and BY something: if it commits to other bytes than the manifest, or if its Bitcoin block is only the calendar's word, saying otherwise would be the one false claim this service cannot make. Same for a mirror record written for other bytes, and for a day still being written when we hash it.

mutations.name: a proof of other bytes is read as a proof of this manifest
mutations.expect: FAIL a proof that commits to OTHER bytes is a fault, never a Bitcoin block beside this hash

mutations.name: a mirror entry written for other bytes is shown under this day
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and so is one entry of other bytes inside a record that otherwise matches

mutations.name: a mirror record of another manifest is shown
mutations.expect: FAIL a record of other bytes is dropped even when its entries name no hash at all

mutations.name: a fresh calendar answer may already claim a Bitcoin block
mutations.find: if (!fresh.length || fresh.some((a) => a.kind !== 'pending')) throw new Error('a fresh calendar answer must be pending only: this one is not')
mutations.expect: FAIL a fresh answer that already claims Bitcoin is refused, and nothing is written

mutations.name: the calendar's word about Bitcoin is published as ours
mutations.expect: FAIL a Bitcoin attestation we have not checked is CLAIMED, never stated

mutations.name: one source confirming a merkle root is enough
mutations.expect: FAIL one source alone is not enough to call it verified

mutations.name: a day still being written is hashed anyway
mutations.find: if (settleMs > 0 && now() - stat.mtimeMs < settleMs) throw new NotSettled(
mutations.expect: FAIL a day whose file was just written is not hashed, and says so as its own kind of error

mutations.name: a proof past the upgrade window stops being looked at
mutations.expect: FAIL the directory: proofs in the window are completed in place, older ones are read but never written

mutations.name: a confirmed record with nobody behind it keeps the word when read
mutations.expect: FAIL confirmed with nobody behind it reads back as in-block-unwitnessed
